structured_advisory_review.scope_limit: Supplemented the Nov 8-14 UTC API search with the Nov 7 UTC boundary page; filtered original published_at into the exact local-calendar window.
structured_advisory_review.disposition: Lead-level screening only. Malware labels and repository commits are not campaign counts. Bee-js has original reports and is selected; strutil-core repeats last week. Other package records remain unverified leads, not individually cleared incidents.

limits: The rolling issue is bounded to 40 article groups; the retained state is bounded too. No claim of exhaustive global incident coverage.
Daily checkpoints are samples, not every hourly run; no additional article URLs were found in those samples.
The 366 retained in-window commit signals were inventoried, not all individually investigated. The malware advisory export is supplemental and does not cover all vulnerability advisories.
None of the six new incident/vulnerability candidates is a current canonical publication. They cannot be inserted into the bot weekly candidate before real review and publication.
The research brief remains outside the incident publisher; no workflow/schema change is part of preparation.
